description.value: Greens Market is an independently owned full-service grocery store in Kitsilano, operating since 2009, specialising in 100% certified organic produce and locally sourced products across produce, butcher, kitchen, cheese, and health and wellness departments. The store is notable for its nose-to-tail butcher shop, an in-house kitchen preparing food from scratch, a zero-waste bulk section, and a health and wellness department staffed by trained specialists. It sits at the corner of Broadway and Maple Street — a well-travelled cycling corridor — and offers online ordering with delivery or curbside pickup.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 18m; rack (6 spaces) at 26m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 49m; stands (4 spaces) at 55m; rack (5 spaces) at 58m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 91m. Total: 31 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the Greens Market website (greensmarket.ca), which loaded successfully and provided detailed department, contact, and access information. The contact page explicitly lists bike routes (7th Ave, 10th Ave, Cypress St) as access options but does not mention bike racks or on-site bike parking. The website confirms the address and provides a phone number absent from OSM; it also consistently uses the shorter name 'Greens Market' rather than OSM's 'Greens Organic and Natural Market'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Greens Organic and Natural Market' but the website consistently uses 'Greens Market' (and occasionally 'Green's Market') as the trading name.
Phone number absent from OSM; 604.568.3079 sourced from website contact page only.
Minor internal inconsistency on website: front page states 'Open since 2010' while produce page states 'When we opened in 2009'.
Bike routes to the store are listed on the contact page but no explicit mention of on-site bike parking or racks; bike parking required criterion could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established independent organic grocery store on a major Kitsilano cycling corridor, with a full range of food options (including hot prepared food and bulk goods) directly relevant to touring cyclists. The contact page explicitly acknowledges cyclist access via named bike routes.

Hot food.detail: In-house kitchen staffed by chefs making 'healthy real food from scratch'; butcher department also offers fully cooked products as one of its three tiers of sale

wow_evidence: contact page explicitly lists bike routes (7th Ave, 10th Ave, Cypress St) as access options
